# Get RSS From Page

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves RSS feeds from page.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getPageRSS(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getPageRSS(url: "https://www.macstories.net/")
~~~~
